AdjustmentIn.title: AdjustmentIn
AdjustmentIn.description:
A superadmin's adjustment of a company's credits: `amount` adds (positive) or removes
(negative); `note` says why, as the company's history shows it; `key` makes a repeated
request count once.

AiSpendOut.title: AiSpendOut
AiSpendOut.description: A company's or user's AI spend over the last SPEND_DAYS days, for its support page.

AutoTopUpIn.title: AutoTopUpIn
AutoTopUpIn.description: Which top-up to buy, and under which available balance (credits).

AutoTopUpOut.title: AutoTopUpOut
AutoTopUpOut.description:
A wallet's automatic top-up: whether it's offered at all, running, or waiting for its
checkout, what it buys and when, and the choices.

BuyerPurchaseOut.title: BuyerPurchaseOut
BuyerPurchaseOut.description: A top-up someone paid for into a company: `total` in minor units, tax included.

CandidatePriceOut.title: CandidatePriceOut
CandidatePriceOut.description:
A candidate's price when credits are bought in a top-up from this amount (minor units of
the catalog's currency).

CandidateTierOut.title: CandidateTierOut
CandidateTierOut.description:
A candidate's price in a top-up of any number of candidates, from this many. From
`upgrade_from` candidates on, the top-up buys the next tier's smallest one instead, which
costs no more (none for the last tier).

CatalogOut.title: CatalogOut
CatalogOut.description: What the pricing page and Paddle.js need. Prices are decided here, not in the client.

CheckoutOut.title: CheckoutOut
CheckoutOut.description: The Paddle transaction the checkout opens, made by billing in the company's currency.

CompanyCurrencyOut.title: CompanyCurrencyOut
CompanyCurrencyOut.description: The currency a company pays in, automatic top-ups included, and the ones to choose.

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description: The currencies prices are in: a country's own where billing sells in it, USD elsewhere.

CurrencyOut.title: CurrencyOut
CurrencyOut.description: The currency someone sees prices in, and the ones they can choose.

CustomTopUpOut.title: CustomTopUpOut
CustomTopUpOut.description:
A top-up of any number of candidates, from `min_candidates` to `max_candidates`, each at
its tier's price, smallest first.

HistoryEntryOut.title: HistoryEntryOut
HistoryEntryOut.description:
One movement of a wallet's credits. `total` (minor units, tax included) and `currency`
are what a top-up cost or an adjustment moved, when known; `transaction_id` is the Paddle
transaction of a top-up or adjustment, and `hold_key` the key of a candidate's credits.

HoldOut.title: HoldOut
HoldOut.description: Credits set aside for one piece of work: open, charged or released.

InvoiceOut.title: InvoiceOut
InvoiceOut.description: A temporary link to the transaction's invoice PDF.

PaymentFailure.title: PaymentFailure
PaymentFailure.description:
Why a checkout's payment failed, as the buyer can act on it; the site says what to do for
each.

reason.description: Why the payment failed, by what the buyer can do.

PaymentFailureOut.title: PaymentFailureOut
PaymentFailureOut.description:
Why a checkout's latest payment failed, as one of a fixed set; the site says what the buyer
can do for each.

PurchaseOwnerOut.title: PurchaseOwnerOut
PurchaseOwnerOut.description: Whose wallet a top-up's transaction paid into.

PushBody.title: PushBody
PushBody.description: What Pub/Sub sends to a push endpoint.

ReferralOut.title: ReferralOut
ReferralOut.description: The owner's referral link code, what it earns, and how many it has earned for.

ReferralRewardOut.title: ReferralRewardOut
ReferralRewardOut.description: A company that came through the link and topped up, so both got the reward.

TopUpCheckoutIn.title: TopUpCheckoutIn
TopUpCheckoutIn.description:
A top-up of this many candidates; billing checks the count and sets the price, in the
company's currency.

TopUpCheckoutOut.title: TopUpCheckoutOut
TopUpCheckoutOut.description: The Paddle transaction the checkout opens.

TopUpOut.title: TopUpOut
TopUpOut.description:
A fixed top-up, as automatic top-up buys it: its price in the catalog's currency (minor
units).
